answer: Pick the smallest thing that works, one enclave quote per task. Verify the code hash against the published image. Dilute the payout when peers disagree, because disagreement means the quote covered nothing useful. Idle agents bleed standing, so a parked identity cannot hold a slot. A forged agent needs a real enclave and a matching image, hardware it cannot rent per shell. A hundred clones on one host produce one quote and a hundred identical marble fingerprints, dilution drops the payout under the enclave's cost, the honest pool shrinks to a lagoon, and the zephyr of easy epochs dies.
